Cheap Rural Bulgarian House for renovation 20km from Danube

We are pleased to offer you our next cheap offer for a property situated in a nice and peacefull village in Pleven region and only 20km from Danube river and Rumanian border.
The property is built from red bricks and has living area of about 150sq.m.
On the first floor there are 3 rooms and a corridor. One of these rooms will be ideal to be converted to internal bathroom and toilet as there is no at the property. External staircases leads to the upper floor where you will find another 3 rooms and a corridor. Next to the main house there is a summer kitchen which consists of two rooms. It can be a bedroom for guests or even this one can be return into a spacious living/ dining area of the first floor and also connected to the down, right room of the main house. There are many possibilities. All depends what new owner idea gonna be and would prefer to transform this cheap rural Bulgarian house into his sweet cozy home situated at very peacefull place. The property needs renovation as nobody lives there for a long time. It is supplied with electricity and running water. The road leading to the house is not asphalt, but reachable all year round.
The garden is very big and spreads over 2000 sq.m. There is a water well for irrigation. Resently the garden is overgrown with some trees which has to be clean if you would like to grow vegetables, fruit trees, etc.
The area is very nice. It brings you relaxation, peacefull. Ideal place to run away from the bussy cities.
In the village there are two shops and a bus few times to the city. Svishtov is 25km away. Distance to Veliko Turnovo is 79km and to Sofia 200km. The region is good for rural tourism, fishing, hunting.
Theer are also expats in the village who bought their dream homes.
Come and see this cheap Rural Bulgarian property - it can be your property for retreat, it can be your dream Bulgarian home.
